failures.stepName: Verify both packaged helper signatures and the x64 final package

firstErrorLine.line: error: The packaged Main JavaScript files are missing or ambiguous.

failures.rootCause: @electron/asar 3.4.1 names entries with the host path separator: listPackage builds them with path.join('/', name), which on Windows gives '\out\main\index.js', and a nested statFile/extractFile splits its argument on path.sep. extractWindowsHelperCompiledPins filtered the listing with a '/'-only pattern, so on Windows it found no Main JavaScript and threw. Its only test ran on Linux Test (desktop), where the separator is '/', and the file is not on the Windows unit lane.
failures.fix: committed separately as fix(hands): read packed Windows Main pins with the asar separator; when this record was written (2026-11-08) the fix was in the working tree only, and this preview, which ran 420912fb before it, does not CI-confirm it. extractWindowsHelperCompiledPins maps listed names from the reader's separator to '/' before the existing checks, rejects duplicate names, and reads each entry with the separator restored; an optional {asar, separator} dependency lets the new test drive the real reader with Windows naming rules on Linux; the test asserts the reader is @electron/asar 3.4.1 and hands it path.sep names, so it also holds on a Windows host
